title: Robot Legion
description: Build a steampunk robot army. Workers automate jobs while combatants fight beside you through three boss dungeons. Trade with engineer villagers for rare parts.
body:
Robot Legion

  Build, command, and fight alongside a steampunk-themed legion of humanoid
  robots. Automate your worker chores, deploy combat squads, breach three tiers of
   boss dungeons, and trade with engineer villagers for rare parts. Robot Legion
  is a content-rich Fabric 1.21.1 mod with worker robots, combat robots, boss
  fights, structures, custom blocks, items, and an in-game guidebook.

  Worker Robots

  Six worker classes automate the grind so you can focus on adventuring.

  - Miner — Scans for ores within a configurable range, tunnels to them with its
  glowing pickaxe, and pillars itself back to the surface when the trip count is
  full.
  - Lumberjack — Fells whole trees and replants saplings.
  - Farmer — Tills soil, plants the crops you select, waters them with the
  watering can equipment series, and harvests on cycle.
  - Porter — Hovering drone with 27 storage slots. Carries chests, barrels and
  smelters that you specify.
  - Crafter — Runs crafting recipes you queue up from its on-board inventory.
  - Animal Handler — Herds, breeds, and shears the livestock you choose.

  Each worker can be assigned a custom work area with the Range Setter, given
  commands (Follow / Stay / Work / Attack), and inspected via the Robot Tracker
  tablet.

  Combat Robots (11 subtypes)

  Your frontline. Mix and match for the right composition.

  - Swordsman — Iron-tier sword wielder. Reliable melee anchor.
  - Tesla Trooper — Dual-arm Tesla gauntlets, mid-range chain lightning. Great
  against groups.
  - Medic — Heals all your robots and you with a passive aura. Essential.
  - Grenadier — Ranged AoE bomber with slowness debuff.

  Three Boss Dungeons

  Each boss drops a unique Trophy + Boss Core used to craft progressively stronger
   gear and to build a Trophy Block that auto-deposits more cores into a linked
  chest over time.

  - Lv1 — Steel Swordmaster at the Abandoned Factory: a Diamond-tier melee duelist
   with phase changes.
  - Lv2 — Bombard Fortress at the Prototype Hangar: a colossal cannon emplacement
  with three-stage barrage attacks. Watch out for the steam vents.
  - Lv3 — Thunder Sorcerer at the Substation Ruins: a teleporting plasma caster
  with a Tesla field and lightning drone summons. The final boss.

  Engineer Villager Trading

  Locate Engineer Huts in plains and forest biomes to find the green-robed
  Engineer villager. Trade with them for Scrap Metal, Circuit Boards, Robot Cores,
   and other essential parts. Out of villagers? Use the Engineer Certificate on
  any regular villager to convert them.

  Two locator items help here: the Engineer Locator maps the nearest Engineer Hut,
   and the Factory Locator maps the nearest dungeon.

  Player Tank

  A steam-powered four-wheeled tank you can ride. Cannon on the left mouse, homing
   rocket on the right. Refuel with coal. Repair and recover with the Tank Wrench.

  Engineer's Manual (in-game guidebook)

  A 53-page illustrated handbook that ships with the mod. Covers every item,
  recipe, robot, dungeon, and boss with crafting tables and walkthroughs.
  Localized into Japanese (日本語), English, and Simplified Chinese (简体中文).
  
Getting Started

  1. Craft the Robot Crafting Bench (Iron, Copper, Planks, Redstone) — this is the
   central crafting station for the mod.
  2. Find an Engineer Villager in their hut (or convert a regular villager).
  3. Trade or craft to gather Scrap Metal, Circuit Boards, and a Robot Core.
  4. Build your first Swordsman Robot and right-click to issue Follow / Stay / Attack commands.
  5. Craft a Boss Map Lv1 and follow it to your first boss fight.

  The Engineer's Manual is auto-granted the first time you join a world.

  Requirements

  - Minecraft 1.21.1
  - Fabric Loader 0.16.0+
  - Fabric API
  - Java 21

  License

  MIT. Source contributions and feedback welcome.
